concept: One running cartoon story, Priya and Dev in one meeting room with one wall board. The vague sentence is rebuilt on that board one slot at a time, then the same meeting is replayed with the rebuilt sentence. One loud thing per frame; the rule is large when it is named.

story.metaphor: The wall board holds the sentence; its slots change state (empty, lit, filled, joined) and the room is cheap to replay.
story.setting: One office meeting room with a wall board.
story.arc: Vague kind sentence, nod, same meeting again; rebuild the sentence in three parts; replay the meeting with the rebuilt sentence.

devices.what: The wall board held as one station. Three slots (behaviour, effect, request) change state across sections: empty, lit, filled, joined.
A corner camera and its viewfinder frame that shows only what was said, when and to whom, and lets attitude bubbles drift out.
The vague remark fades to grey while the specific one stays sharp and solid: the ghost of the first meeting, the old label, card A.
A wall calendar with two markers, next meeting and talk after it, joined by a thin line.
The named rule, large and alone on the paper ground. It is the rest frame after each section.
Join material: handoff. The board and its sentence carry across to and from the presenter.
